title: The browser's own events: page views, actions, uploads and errors shown, in the record under the visit
request: Phase 1's second remaining gap: UI events from the web app (page viewed, element acted on, upload started and finished, error shown) under the visit, never a form's contents; adoptable by the main product.
spec: Five kinds in the contract with a validator that refuses anything but routes, names, codes and counts; a batched route under the visit; the page noting views, actions, uploads and errors; a browser check.
plan: Put the kinds and the validator in dclab_core.
Add the route beside the sessions' routes, open to any signed-in role.
Hook the page's show, click, toast, failed and upload paths.
Test the validator, the route and the guard; add the browser check.

decisions.decision: An action is named by its id or data name, never by its text.
decisions.why: A button's text can hold a column's name or a value; an id never does.

decisions.decision: The validator refuses values with spaces or the punctuation of prose.
decisions.why: A form's contents, a query string or a message cannot pass as a route or a code.

decisions.decision: The route is open to every signed-in role and a signed-out page sends nothing.
decisions.why: The record is of the person's own sitting; a signed-out page has no visit of a person.

change: dclab_core experience.py (kinds, UI_KINDS, ui_payload), adapters/main_product_experience.py, CHANGELOG 0.39.0; dclab_rnd pages/sessions.py (the route), accounts/guard.py; web core.js (the ui module, hooks, export), views/home.html (uploads), api.js and the static build; scripts/browser_e2e.py (the check); tests test_ui_events (new), test_experience_finder, test_web_client; CORE_INTEGRATION.md, the plan.

findings.defect: The upload event's field was named like the envelope's kind.
findings.scenario: A batch item's kind collided with the file's kind.

findings.defect: An empty pane failed the validator.
findings.scenario: Every page view without a pane would have been refused.
findings.cause: The name pattern needs one character.
findings.fix: An empty string is left out, not refused.

findings.defect: Two tests listed the routes and the browser checks as they were.
findings.scenario: The finder's route test and the web-client test failed on the additions.
findings.fix: The browser route listed apart with its permission; the check added.

findings.defect: Five kinds were added to the experience event while it stayed v3; the frozen v3 baseline differed from the generated schema.
findings.scenario: tests.test_core_contracts refused the shape change under the same version; a v3 reader in the main product would refuse a ui.* event.
findings.cause: A kind vocabulary is part of a contract's shape.
findings.fix: experience_event.v4 (v1 to v3 read as v4), make core-schemas, the pins in the wheel check and the tests.

findings.defect: A signed-out page recorded the Sign in click; its batch was answered 401 and the page replaced the sign-in error with 'Your session ended'.
findings.scenario: DCLAB_AUTH=password, a wrong password, click Sign in: two seconds later the message changes and the config is dropped; every click posts again.
findings.cause: The click hook ran before sign-in and a 401 on a quiet request still opened the sign-in box.
findings.fix: ui.note records nothing while the page is signed out; request() leaves the 401 of a quiet call alone.
findings.test: test_sign_in_sessions_tokens_switches_and_roles_are_in_the_record (a signed-out POST is 401 and writes nothing)

findings.defect: The browser check proved a page view of Learn only: no click, no wizard.
findings.scenario: The package's done-when names Home, the wizard and a project.
findings.cause: The check was written for the smallest case.
findings.fix: The check clicks the Learn link, opens the wizard and expects ui.action and the two views in the visit's timeline.
findings.test: scripts/browser_e2e.py check_ui_events (needs Chromium, pending the owner's approval)

findings.defect: An infinite count passed the validator; the file store wrote Infinity and PostgreSQL refused the row.
findings.scenario: curl sends bytes 1e400: json.loads gives inf; recorded on files, lost on PostgreSQL and counted as neither recorded nor refused.
findings.cause: The count check tested the sign and NaN only.

findings.defect: The batch sent on page hide could be cancelled by the unload, and a batch was spliced off before the client was checked.
findings.scenario: Closing the tab after the last clicks loses them.
findings.fix: keepalive: true on the batch; the queue is checked before it is spliced.

findings.defect: The validator would accept a column name as an element name if a page ever built an id from one.
findings.scenario: Today no page does (ids and data names are fixed words); the pane comes from the address bar verbatim.
findings.cause: The rule lives on the page side.
findings.fix: The rule is written where names are read; left open as a page-side rule, not a check.

outcome: The browser's page views, actions, uploads and errors are in the record under the visit, and nothing a person typed can enter through them. Reviewed (6 findings fixed, one left as a page-side rule); the contract is v4.
lessons: A browser event's name must come from an id, never from what the element shows.
A validator in the contract makes the same refusal hold in every product that sends the events.
risks: make browser-test runs on a machine with Chromium; the unit tests cover the route and the validator without it.
